hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in "$HOME"/Downloads/OfficeSwap/*) cd "$HOME/Downloads/OfficeSwap" && git add -A && { git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "Auto-update from Claude Code"; } && git push origin main ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
